title: Read UAV Trajectory
text: Generate translation and rotation samples from UAV trajectory for 3D simulation, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Trajectory object} sets Trajectory object; {Trajectory source} sets the source for trajectory From trajectory object, {UAV scenario object}, {UAV platform name} sets the name and {Convert to ENU reference frame and Front-Left-Up body frame} sets the translation and rotation coordinate frame. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Time
ports.summary: Time point to sample along trajectory scalar

params.name: Trajectory source
params.values: Source for trajectory From trajectory object in workspace (default) | From UAV Scenario in workspace

params.name: UAV scenario object
params.values: UAV scenario object singleUAVScenario (default) | uavScenario object

params.name: UAV platform name
params.values: Name of UAV platform UAV (default) | name of UAV platform

params.name: Trajectory object
params.values: Trajectory object waypointTrajectory() (default) | multirotorFlightTrajectory object | fixedwingFlightTrajectory object | polynomialTrajectory object | waypointTrajectory object

params.name: Convert to ENU reference frame and Front-Left-Up body frame
params.values: Translation and rotation coordinate frame on (default) | off
